_comment: Argo's honest self-description of its OWN stack, fed to the frontier-evolution mapper (argo_evolve) so it can judge whether a release unlocks a real upgrade. Keep this current: an evolution PR that adopts a feature must move it from api_features_not_used to api_features_used in the same PR.

models.premium: claude-opus-4-8 (env ARGO_CHAT_MODEL_PREMIUM; rehearse judge + fix authoring)

api_features_used: temperature omitted for models that reject it (opus-4-8, gpt-5/o-series)
api_features_not_used: structured outputs (output_config json_schema) - JSON replies are regex-parsed today
prompt caching (cache_control) - the big system prompt is re-billed every turn
Batch API (50 percent cheaper for non-latency-sensitive calls like SEAS scoring)
adaptive thinking (thinking type adaptive on premium calls)
token usage telemetry (no per-call cost recording exists yet)
runtime: python 3.11 stdlib-first; Railway web (webhook + in-process local scheduler for diagnose/frontier) + GitHub Actions hourly scheduler (project/watch/reflect)
known_gotchas: claude-opus-4-8 rejects the temperature param (400); argo_observe omits it
new dependencies are not allowed without explicit reason (stdlib-first rule)
